description: Unit test code for the RebaselineCL command in the WebKit project, testing rebaselining of layout tests and related operations.

classes.name: RebaselineCLTest
classes.description: Test suite for the RebaselineCL command, covering various scenarios such as executing with issue numbers, triggering builds, and rebaselining tests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, mocks builds, git interactions, and test results.

methods.name: command_options
methods.description: Creates command line options for tests.

methods.name: test_execute_with_issue_number_given
methods.description: Tests rebaseline execution when an issue number is provided.

methods.name: test_execute_with_no_issue_number
methods.description: Tests behavior when no issue number is found.

methods.name: test_execute_with_issue_number_from_branch
methods.description: Tests rebaseline when issue number is obtained from branch.

methods.name: test_execute_with_only_changed_tests_option
methods.description: Tests rebaseline with only changed tests option.

methods.name: test_execute_with_flaky_test_that_fails_on_retry
methods.description: Tests handling of flaky tests that fail on retries.

methods.name: test_execute_with_no_retry_summary_downloaded
methods.description: Tests behavior when retry summary is unavailable.

methods.name: test_bails_when_one_build_is_missing_results
methods.description: Tests early exit when build results are missing.

methods.name: test_bails_when_there_are_unstaged_baselines
methods.description: Tests early exit when unstaged baseline files are present.
